profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years experience in back end APIs, microservices, and desktop applications.  Extensive experience in the entertainment fields relating to film distribution and visual effects.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Defined architectural documentation for legacy production critical application.
Mentored team members and contractors on engineering principles, and best practices.
Increased system observability by leading in best practices, OTEL instrumentation, and dashboards.
Reduced false failure alerts by 90% through structured and guided logging practices.
Added API level validation while advocating for standards and improved documentation.

positions.title: Media Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed serverless event system for stable backup, and replay of 10,000s of events.  Controls replay rate with various mechanics to reduce strain on downstream services.
* Extend orchestration media management workflows to improve delivery efficiency and support new requirements.
* Enhanced code quality by implementing unit testing, linting, and type hinting as best practices.
* Created various DataDog dashboards for services’ observability.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Software Development · Software Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Golang Engineer
positions.description:
* Built high throughput, low latency RESTful microservices at Paramount+’s video streaming.
* Collaborated with front-end developers to build RESTful APIs for dynamic page design.
* Improved Github Actions with Helm and Kubernetes integration within CI/CD flows.
* Authored API and user documentation for services; implemented automated deployment.
* Designed database models/queries for API and user search.  Created database migration workflow.
* Enhanced service observability with New Relic for performance analysis and stability reporting.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · REST APIs · RESTful WebServices · GitHub Actions · Continuous Integration · Back-End Web Development · Testing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Code Review · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Terraform · Linux · Unit Testing · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Docker Products · SQL · Go (Programming Language) · Software Deployment · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Git · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected and maintained well tested cinema applications, collaborating with clients for continued improvement.
* Led a small team in replacing business critical software to reduce costs, code complexity, and development down time .
* Championed the creation of asset tracking microservices for cinema assets in Amazon Web Services to increase production speed.
* Solved certificate security and auditing challenges with a distributed management service
* Engineered custom software deployment, and package management system to securely bypass network isolation constraints.
* Exercised complete technical ownership over a suite of services, applications, libraries, APIs, etc.
* Collaborated across teams to develop and maintain APIs, while actively contributing to both internal and open-source libraries.
* Handled the transition between OAuth2 providers to align applications with the company environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Added production management integration, via RESTful APIs, to existing production tool sets and applications.
* Enforced Agile methodologies to drive project success, high quality software, and foster a collaborative environment.
* Led the development of projection system control software; improved user training, workload, and productivity.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
* Assumed management of various tools for the digital cinema mastering process.
* Designed and implemented PyQT application to standardize digital cinema asset creation processes globally.

positions.title: Pipeline Developer
positions.description:
* Designed cloud based, full stack visual effects pipeline in an Agile startup environment.
* Created pages, views, and routers using Backbone.js, bootstrap, and underscore.
* Created RESTful API for use with web and desktop application using Flask.
* Designed MongoDB models using the Python wrapper mongoengine.
* Cross platform PyQT based, multi-processing, file transfer application for S3 storage.
* Setup continuous integration, and license servers on EC2 instances.
* Created GUI for building complex Mongo queries for users, simplifying the developer's job of creating custom filters.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description: Created small asset management application with Python, and PyQt for artists.  It's main functionality is for remote users to be able to transfer assets between their machines and the company's services while conforming to the pipeline.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
As a TD I worked in every aspect of the pipeline.  From handling ingestible materials, to troubleshooting artists' projects, to creating delivery systems for clients.  Stereo D was unique in that it touches every frame of the films it works on.  It's pipeline was specifically developed to handle the intricacies of stereo conversion.
Worked on Nuke pipeline integration for automated versioning, rendering, and asset management.
* Contributed to proprietary asset management and production tracking software.
* Created Python modules for centralizing file system logic and offloading file management to workstations.
* Created PyQt front end for asset management and production tracking software.
* Managed proprietary and third party software, and software deployment systems.
* Supported artists' workflows with tools, plugins, and scripts within third party software.

Films:
* Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
* The Wolverine
* R.I.P.D.
* Pacific Rim
* Star Trek Into Darkness
* Iron Man 3
* Jurassic Park 3D
* G.I. Joe: Retaliation
* Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters
* Katy Perry: Part of Me
* The Avengers
* Titanic 3D
* John Carter of Mars
* Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter

positions.title: VFX Artist
positions.description:
Handled ingesting and quality control of visual effects vendor generated elements, optimized for stereoscopic conversion.
Managed custom Nuke python modules, and tools for the conversion process.

Films:
* Captain America: The First Avenger
* Thor
